# Missing Configuration File Handling

If the configuration file 'kc.toml' does not exist in the specified repository directory, the code raises a CompileError. This could lead to failures in the compilation process, potentially affecting the overall functionality of the knowledge compiler.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.read_config`
